body_text:
Chain rule. If $f$ is differentiable at $x$ and $g$ is
differentiable at $f(x)$, then $g\circ f$ is differentiable at $x$
and $(g\circ f)'(x)=g'(f(x))f'(x)$. The statement expresses
composition of the two best linear approximations; the error terms
remain of smaller order than the original increment.
